title: Game idea: Multiplayer Drone Game Idea 🚁
author: MammothLast9280
selftext:
Hey guys,

I don't have a Claude Code subscription, but I've seen people here making some really cool games. So I thought I'd share a game idea.

**Game idea:**  
A multiplayer drone game where you fly a drone through an old, haunted house. You have to follow a given route and finish it within a time limit.

**Some fun obstacles:**

* Wind that pushes your drone around
* Dogs and cats trying to catch it
* Fireworks, insects, Spider-Man 😂
* Random surprises inside the house

It would be even more fun as a multiplayer game where you race against other players to finish first without crashing.

Just an idea I had. Would be cool if someone tried making it!

**Note:** I'm only sharing the idea, not offering to pay anyone to build it. Feel free to use it!

comments.author: because-potato
comments.body: I think this idea sounds fun to only you. And that’s fine, but maybe you should make it yourself
